lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-luminance spots are visible between the pectoral fin insertion and the first dorsal fin, arranged in a semi-regular grid configuration.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance circular spots to form a series of grid-like nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with light-toned upper surfaces and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10 discrete high-luminance spots of varying sizes are distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, clustered mainly toward the base and trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin, and an attached remora is present on the upper dorsal flank posterior to the gill region.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots is visible on the upper surface of the pectoral fin.
